test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A) the painter

(B) has completed

(C) the mural

(D) beautifully
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **ABCD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "the painter," which is correctly indicated by **part (A).**
 
• Following the subject, "has completed" **(AB)** logically continues the action performed by the painter.
 
• **The next part,** "the mural," indicates the object of the action, which is correctly indicated by (C).
 
• **Ending with** "beautifully" (D) adds the adverb to describe how the action was performed, completing the sentence logically.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ABCD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (ABDC):** This option places "beautifully" before "the mural," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (ACBD):** This option places "the mural" before "has completed," which makes the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This option places "has completed" before the subject "the painter," which disrupts the proper sequence.
